findings.title: Removing `findMany` breaks existing service callers
findings.body: This replaces the public `findMany` method with `getBaseConditions`, which only returns a SQL predicate and does not execute a booking query. Existing callers of `InsightsBookingService.findMany(...)` will no longer type-check, and this PR does not migrate them to a replacement API. Keep a query method or update all callers before removing it.
